title: Resume
lead: For BPS-15 and above. Upload your resume to fill your profile faster, or build it section by section.
pdfUnavailable: The PDF is made by the server, so it isn't available in demo mode.
builderLead: Everything here is saved to your profile and used in your resume PDF.
checkThisHint: We weren't sure we read this correctly. Please check it.

upload.title: Upload your resume
upload.lead: We read your resume and suggest values for each section. Nothing is saved until you confirm it.
upload.hint: PDF or Word (.docx). Scanned images can't be read; build your resume below instead.
upload.parsed: Check each suggestion below and add the ones that are right.
upload.unreadable: It may be a scan or an image. Fill in the sections below instead.

details.title: Personal and contact details
details.lead: These values come from your resume. Correct anything that's wrong, then confirm.
details.none: No personal or contact details were found in your resume.

statement.title: Statement of purpose
statement.label: Statement of purpose
statement.hint: A short paragraph on why you want this kind of post. Up to 4,000 characters.

skills.addHint: Press Enter to add, e.g. AutoCAD or HTV licence.
